remarks: HARD to FIND custom-built Donato Builders RANCH with all the desired amenities found in today's custom new-builds.  Experience Ai-STAGING: SEE BEYOND THE EMPTY ROOMS TOUR featuring 1,950 sf to show its light, well-maintained, open-floor-plan, impressive natural sunlight, 8ft ceilings, expanding the generously sized living spaces.  Extra features: 1st floor-laundry room with large vacuum/broom closet plus deep-utility-sink;  find easily-expanded  2nd bath-shower (per plans) and large conveniently located 7.5 ft pantry (Other Rm1), large-U-Shaped-Kitchen w/solid oak-cabinets,  neutral Corian countertops/matching double sink. NOW START the SEE BEYOND THE EMPTY ROOMS TOUR, unlock, walk into the foyer, be greeted by the Great-Room with brick-wood-burning fireplace(gas-starter) flanked by Andersen casements w/French-door leading out to short staircase onto colored-stamped-concrete patio(25x15ft). Heading back inside, you're back in the Great-Room(21x17ft) turn left, you're in the Family-Room(16x14ft) with matching casements. Turn into the Dinette(14x18ft) that beams natural light through the spindles & bow-3-window-nook, plus breakfast-bar(9ft) for extra seating; see double-6-paneled doors, open them to find shelved-pantry(7.5ft) to hold appliances/party pieces. Step into the working U-Shaped Kitchen(10x18ft) with ample raised-paneled oak cabinets, Corian sink & counter-tops, find a desk/nook for paying bills. Peek into 1st-floor-laundry-room with deep-sink & large closet, OR open the door to 2-car garage w/inside water faucet OR notice the 2nd full-bathroom, with glass-door-shower, with room to expand depth/width(per plan). March down the hall to the bedrooms, there's two good-sized rooms w/ceiling fans and roomy closets, just ahead see the king-sized Primary Bedroom (16.6x14.5ft) with a large closet. Check out the full-bath with beige tub/shower, large double-vanity sinks, ample lighting.   Last place to visit is the basement; deep, L-Shaped open, dry, insulated, expandable space with newer Hi-Efficient furnace,  extra electric plugs distributed throughout. You are invited to SEE BEYOND THE EMPTY ROOMS, an AI-STAGING TOUR to experience this unique custom-built home.
